Apple TV's recent slate of new shows has been quite rich, and another one is about to be added. "Small Prophets" is a British comedy premiering next week that has received a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Here is the trailer.

"Small Prophets" premieres on Apple TV on October 7, with audiences and critics alike unanimous in their praise.

Last month, Apple TV did something quite rare: it acquired the streaming rights to an existing series from another network.

The British comedy "Small Prophets" premiered in the UK earlier this year and was a hit on the BBC, earning a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Now Apple will bring this widely popular series to audiences around the world.

"Small Prophets" will premiere its first two episodes on Apple TV on October 7 (Wednesday), with one new episode released each week thereafter until November 4.

Apple today released the trailer for "Small Prophets" for an early look. Here is a synopsis of the series, followed by the trailer:

"Small Prophets" is created, written and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who is also the creator of "Detectorists" and has appeared in "The Office" (UK version) and "Pirates of the Caribbean".

Note: "Small Prophets" will be available on Apple TV globally, but UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 to watch it.

Current comedies airing on Apple TV include "Brothers" starring Matthew McConaughey, as well as the fourth season of "Ted Lasso". The popular series "Stick" starring Owen Wilson is also set to return.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, with discount offers available via Apple One bundles.
